summary: Suja Life, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its initial public offering (IPO) of Class A common stock, which closed on May 8, 2026. The company sold 8,888,889 firm shares at $21.00 per share via underwriters led by Goldman Sachs, Jefferies, and William Blair, with a 30-day over-allotment option for up to 1,333,333 additional shares. The IPO is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation event. It involves no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situation trigger. The filing also covers customary underwriting agreement terms, a director designation agreement, and an amended limited partnership agreement. No special-situation event is present; the transaction is a standard equity issuance.
